title: Quick Peruvian Beef Brochette
description: A simple and flavorful grilled beef skewer inspired by Peruvian cuisine. This dish is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality beef for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Red onion, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Add a sweet and crunchy texture to the skewer

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
Fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Add a fresh and herbaceous flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Brighten the flavors with a squeeze of fresh lime juice

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Add a pungent and aromatic flavor

ingredients.name: Aji amarillo pepper, minced
ingredients.notes: Add a spicy and slightly sweet flavor

instructions: Thread beef, onion, bell pepper, and cilantro onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, garlic, and aji amarillo pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the skewers, making sure to coat all the ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
